context:
Treat this as the integration gate for the remediation chain. First prove the
matrix and compatibility accounting are correct, then run the full sweep, then
commit only the compact durable facts needed for release readiness.
description:
After auth propagation, explicit compatibility rules, LakeSail remediation,
timeout hardening, and Explorer external-corpus smoke are implemented, rerun
the corrected enabled-platform UAT for `lakesail`, `pg-duckdb`, `pg-mooncake`,
and `timescaledb`.

The goal is not merely a green command. The release gate must prove that every
non-compatibility-blocked benchmark runs for each enabled platform, validation
is clean wherever validators exist, packaging/report phases complete, Explorer
smoke passes against the packaged corpus, and any excluded benchmark has a
durable compatibility rule.

anti_patterns.dont: accept a green run that skipped failed benchmarks without compatibility rules
commit raw `cells.jsonl`, screenshots, Playwright reports, command logs, or binary result bundles
run multiple Docker stacks concurrently or use global Docker prune commands

verifications.expected: `command-status.json` returns 0, or any nonzero exit is tied only to explicitly accepted compatibility-blocked cells

verifications.command:
test -n "$BENCHBOX_UAT_RUN_DIR" && uv run -- python - <<'PY'
import os
from pathlib import Path
run = Path(os.environ['BENCHBOX_UAT_RUN_DIR'])
for name in ['matrix_summary.tsv', 'validator_rollup.tsv', 'uat_lifecycle.log', 'playwright_smoke.log']:
    print(name, (run / name).exists())
PY

work_units.notes:
The final 2026-05-14 sweep on this branch passed every executed cell.
The last remediation pass fixed FlightData CSV NULL handling for
PostgreSQL-family COPY, kept real `.csv` inputs in CSV COPY mode when
`csv_null_marker=""`, added emitted pg-extension platform names
(`pg_duckdb`, `pg_mooncake`) to the submission validator allow-list, and
promoted LakeSail `vector_search` from an all-query compatibility skip to
an explicit benchmark gate. Evidence-backed benchmark gates also cover
PostgreSQL-family `joinorder` and `tpcds_obt`, pg_mooncake `tpcds`, and
TimescaleDB `datavault`.

Final full gate:
`/Users/joe/Developer/benchmark_runs/logs/uat_enabled_platforms_full_20260514/`.
Phase exit codes were all zero. Matrix accounting reported 88 candidates,
64 executed, 24 compatibility-pruned, 64 passed, 0 failed, 0 timed out.
Validator clean rate met the 1.0 floor for submittable bundles; three
TPC-DS subscale bundles were visible as `refused-by-cli` because they are
intentionally unofficial subscale outputs. Explorer external-corpus smoke
passed in Chromium against the packaged corpus. UAT Docker lifecycle was
sequential and clean; post-run `make uat-docker-cleanup APPLY=1` removed
the UAT-owned LakeSail image and left only non-UAT base images.
work_units.summary: Remediate remaining PG extension and TimescaleDB red cells
